context: Daichi and Aoi taste-test a dessert.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (甘い/カップ/素材/快適/過ぎる) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: このケーキ、ちょっと甘いなあ。
lines.en: This cake is a bit sweet.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 甘過ぎた?素材を変えてみようか。
lines.en: Too sweet? Shall I change the ingredients?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 素材はええで。砂糖が過ぎただけや。
lines.en: The ingredients are fine. Just too much sugar.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: このカップに、盛り付けると可愛いよ。
lines.en: Plated in this cup, it looks cute.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええカップやな。座り心地も快適や。
lines.en: Nice cup. The seating's comfortable too.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 快適な店にしたくて、頑張ってるの。
lines.en: I'm working to make it a comfortable shop.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 甘さを抑えたら、もっと売れるで。
lines.en: Cut the sweetness and it'll sell more.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 良い素材で、甘過ぎない味にするね。
lines.en: With good ingredients, I'll make it not too sweet.
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
